issues.claim: "`Include` loads only the navigation it names. The items are loaded, but this query does not fill their `Product` property"
issues.problem: Product can still be non-null if the products are already tracked (fixup) or lazy loading is on. The wording "this query does not fill" is accurate, but it could be read as absolute.
issues.suggestedFix: Make it explicit: "this query does not load their `Product` (it is non-null only if those products happen to be tracked already or lazy loading is enabled)". Mirror the change in ru.
